title: Fork Moonshine: WASM thread-pool size and no-spin option
description: Moonshine's WASM build sizes its pthread pool to navigator.hardwareConcurrency and ONNX Runtime workers spin between passes (spike chatticus-a2000f: 16% of a core in silence at 10 threads vs 4% at 2). Implement a clean, upstreamable feature in our own fork: a load-time option for pool size and for disabling intra-op spinning. Do NOT open a PR to moonshine-ai; upstreaming waits on an explicit human decision.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Fork made: https://github.com/AnthusAI/moonshine (public, a GitHub fork of moonshine-ai/moonshine). Branch feature/wasm-thread-count-and-no-spin, one commit bd33d068, based on upstream dev-v0.1.6 (their AGENTS.md says PRs target dev-v<version>), not main. Options: C++ core ort_intra_op_threads and ort_allow_spinning (common option parser, process-wide, defaults unchanged); WASM MicTranscriber.threads(n), allowSpinning(bool), LoadModuleOptions.threadPoolSize, link flag PTHREAD_POOL_SIZE=Module.pthreadPoolSize||navigator.hardwareConcurrency. 18 files, 304 insertions: formatted with clang-format per core/.clang-format, banned-constructs check OK, native ort-utils test 2 cases 15 assertions pass, tsc clean, node tests for the pool size 9 pass, full WASM npm test 198 tests 0 fail. NOT verified: no emcc so no WASM build (the CMake || expression and Module.pthreadPoolSize at runtime are unproven), the model-based C++ test (needs fetched model assets), no CPU measurement of the final change. A local checkout already existed at /Users/home/Projects/moonshine with an earlier uncommitted attempt from a previous session (origin pointed at upstream); it was reworked, origin now points at the fork and upstream push is DISABLED. NO pull request exists to moonshine-ai (verified read-only) and none on the fork. Draft PR description in ASD-STE100, not submitted: scratchpad moonshine-pr-draft.md. Chatticus code unchanged: the core-count workaround in web/lib/voice-session.ts stays until the fork build is verified and the user settles it with the maintainers.

right_now_summary: The forked changes pass available tests, but WASM verification and a human upstreaming decision remain.
